{{Quote|Be careful. The base has a lot of enforcers training around it as well as a possible small Imperial force there.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium|Quellium]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
The '''N.S.H. base''' was a facility on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] used by the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|When you reach the base you'll find a training ground area where there is always a contingent of N.S.H. Enforcers in the middle of drills.|[[Trezya Nenei]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
The N.S.H. base was the headquarters of the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony, a [[Mercenary/Legends|Mercenary unit]] that operated on the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], during the Galactic Civil War. It was located in a region of Talus known as the [[Ageyn Foothills]]. The base consisted of a watch tower and an underground bunker within a walled perimeter.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In addition to base's staff of N.S.H. personnel, [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], [[Torture/Legends|torture]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]], the base was also guarded by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="SWG:MO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Medical Officer|Talus}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I don't know the base layout well except to say that it has multiple floors. There should be a security access computer on the main floor that will not only give you access to the lower levels, but also tell you where Syirlabradawk is.|Trezya Nenei, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
[[File:Nightstrike_Soldier_Hegemony.jpg|thumb|left|N.S.H. troops in the base.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony was affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and directly involved in the fight against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and their allies of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> N.S.H. troops shut down an A.C.L.O. clinic and imprisoned the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] medical officer [[Syirlabradawk]]. They also confiscated a shipment of medical supplies before its delivery to Rebel forces on Talus. Alliance [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium|Quellium]] and the A.C.L.O. representative [[Trezya Nenei]] therefore sent a spacer to the N.S.H. base. The spacer assaulted the base and slayed many N.S.H. enforcers in the process.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> The spacer then found a number of [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] held and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] in [[Prison/Legends|holding cells]] within the underground bunker, including the Wookiee Syirlabradawk.<ref name="SWG:MO" /> The spacer also retrieved the medical supply crates, with the A.C.L.O emblems on the crates hastily covered by the N.S.H. logo.<ref name="SWG:RI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The N.S.H. base was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The N.S.H. base was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
